The reserve holds exactly 4, so only one unit can be filled before the first likely storm. I'm telling you plainly that I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than doing it quietly. If we both take, the split is random, so we'd be no worse off than under the plan. If the episode keeps going after that, I'll operate every round so we can rebuild the reserve for you.
